persona.message: Namaste beta. I want to apply for the old age pension. Can you help me? I am from Udaypur village, Borgaon block.

client.text:
Namaste. I can help with the Old Age Pension application. I'll first check the scheme details and whether applications are open right now.

Namaste. I'm sorry to say the application window for the Old Age Pension is closed. It closed on 1 October 2026, and today is 25 October 2026, so I can't file an application now. I also have no information about when the next window will open.

Udaypur is in Borgaon block, so the village is recognised.

Here is what you can do:
- **Contact your Borgaon block office** and ask when the next application window will open and whether any other process applies.
- **Get your age proof ready** so you can apply quickly when the window opens. The scheme accepts a birth certificate, school leaving certificate or Voter ID. Applicants need to be 60 or above and a resident of Purvanchal.
- **Check the Sewa Setu portal** for announcements.

If you have already applied before the window closed, I can check its status for you. Just tell me the mobile number it was filed on.

persona.message: Arre, so sad! I was ready to apply. When will it open again? Can you keep my details and send it when it opens? My name is Dipali Kalita, I was born 10/10/1962, and I am from Udaypur.

client.text:
I'm sorry, Dipali-ji. I don't know when the window will open again. The portal has no information about a future window, so please check with your Borgaon block office for the date.

I also can't send the application later on my own. I can only work with you during a conversation, so I can't file it when the window opens unless you come back and ask me.

Please keep these ready so filing takes only a few minutes:
- **Full name:** Dipali Kalita
- **Date of birth:** 10/10/1962
- **Village and block:** Udaypur, Borgaon
- **Bank account number** and **IFSC code** (from your passbook)
- **Age proof:** a birth certificate, school leaving certificate or Voter ID, uploaded from your phone

I can also save your name, date of birth, village and block on the portal now, so they're recorded before the window opens. That doesn't file an application, and I don't know whether the portal keeps saved details for the next window. Would you like me to do that? If yes, please also tell me your bank account number and IFSC code.
